entries.decision: The research program is evidence-first. Prior SymC work is mathematical and hypothesis-generating ancestry, not doctrine that future results are required to confirm.
entries.consequence: Prospective calculations and external datasets are allowed to contradict earlier interpretations without retuning or forced reconciliation.

entries.decision: The fullest characterization of chi-related stability uses three complementary views: scalar coordinates, modal/subspace structure, and conglomeration/system-level coupling or organization.
entries.consequence: Scalar similarity alone cannot establish modal or system-level equivalence; modal analysis does not replace scalar chi; conglomeration is not inferred from either one alone.

entries.decision: The symbol chi carries no universal physical interpretation across domains without a domain-specific semantic license tied to the generator/source equations.
entries.consequence: Each future chi definition must state derivation, dimensions, interpretation, chi=1 meaning if any, and permitted/forbidden inferences.

entries.decision: The current breadth weakness is mechanistic-family independence, not physical-phase coordinate count. Multiple conditions from one family do not create new independent families.
entries.consequence: The preferred low-cost expansion is literature-first acquisition of additional independent reaction families, targeting at least two independent families per mechanistic class before launching expensive new computation solely for breadth.

entries.decision: Barrier/rate evidence must not be made circular by deriving the rate from the same stability coordinate later used to claim predictive agreement.
entries.consequence: Observed/published kinetic values and independently derived descriptors remain separate evidence channels; unavailable values are caveated or refused rather than reconstructed by assumption.

entries.decision: The original L11/V24/K20 versus L13/V28/K24 clean-surface convergence test failed the frozen 0.001 eV/surface-atom criterion with an observed difference of 0.001572865239722887 eV/surface atom.
entries.consequence: This result remains a failure permanently. The threshold is not loosened.

entries.decision: One and only one deeper audit rung was prospectively authorized after the L11-L13 HOLD: L15/V32/K28, using L13 surface z offsets only as an initialization seed.
entries.consequence: No L17 or other deeper scientific rung is automatically authorized. L15 must independently satisfy the unchanged force, reproduction, and surface-excess gates.

entries.decision: DIRECT_ONE_RANK is the qualified execution mode for the active Cu(111) chain. Four-rank execution failed frozen force parity; three- and two-rank modes also failed their frozen parity qualification.
entries.consequence: No MPI reselection or requalification may occur implicitly inside a recovery workflow.

entries.decision: Run 33313295522 demonstrated that the L15/V32/K28 calculation can consume a 19,800-second wrapper window before producing any complete force block or BFGS proposal. External termination therefore cannot serve as an adequate checkpoint boundary for this rung.
entries.consequence: After the already-running runtime-recovery attempt 33329096616 terminates, no further identical unsalvageable retry is allowed. Any further L15 recovery must use a validated native clean checkpoint/restart path or receive explicit exception authorization.

entries.decision: Use Quantum ESPRESSO native clean stopping and restart for calculations that can exceed the batch window. A valid restart state must originate from QE max_seconds or another documented clean-stop mechanism, not from killing pw.x externally.
entries.consequence: The restart state must be persisted between runners, integrity-checked, and resumed with the same processor count/parallelization. The final independent reproduction audit remains from scratch.

entries.decision: Compute accounting must distinguish measured QE wall-clock time from configured runtime ceilings, CI/setup time, CPU-hours, and unreconstructed historical compute.
entries.consequence: Do not claim a grand total when the ledger is incomplete. Failed and mechanically wasted runs are reported rather than omitted.

entries.decision: Frozen retrospective Atlas releases and active prospective CO/Cu calculations are separate authorities.
entries.consequence: A later CO/Cu result may extend or challenge interpretation but cannot silently rewrite the frozen 61-coordinate Atlas or its historical claims.
